data.content_ref: inline:The transfer claim maps the largest integer to the 'lightest counterweight' on a balance scale, but in the stated analogy all three weights are integers summing to 138 (44, 46, 48) and are not themselves weights of differing mass; the fulcrum is the mean position, not a weight. Thus the claim that the largest integer corresponds to the 'lightest' counterweight is an unmotivated, physically spurious correspondence rather than a valid structural transfer.
